text: Move between the options by pressing the joystick up or down. With Reset trip 1 selected, press the centre of the joystick to reset Trip 1. Selecting Reset trip 1 shows a confirmation popup for the reset. Trip 1 is one of the details shown on the advanced dashboard. The manual does not say how to reach the reset trip options from the dashboard screen.
